text:
maya: Heads up — thinking about adding an "Effective access" toggle to the Role editor. When enabled it expands routes to show why a role can/can't access (inherited role, scope, quota). Thoughts?
leo: Love the idea. main worry: perf on large tenants with 10k routes. :thinking_face:
sam: we can lazy-load per-route and aggregate counts, show a top-level summary first. Cache per-tenant simulation results for 30s.
katie: UX question: default on or off? Admins might be surprised to see lots of denies.
maya: propose default off, with an inline "Preview changes" CTA on bulk edits that runs a simulation and shows diffs.
sam: backend sketch:
```
POST /admin/v1/simulate-access
{ "role_id": "r-123", "routes": ["/v1/generate","/v1/embed"], "preview_mode": true }
```
returns explanation objects per-route.
leo: + perf note: add paginated simulation and queue long jobs, return job_id for heavy requests.
katie: copy note for modal: "This preview simulates effective access and may differ from live entitlements if configuration changed." maybe add :warning: emoji.
maya: telemetry: we should log rbac.preview_opened, rbac.simulate_finished, include selected_route_count and sampling flag (no PII).
sam: agree. anonymize tenant and role IDs, include boolean flags only. also add feature flag ff.rbac_effective_preview.
infra-bot: Deploy scheduled: eng-platform/staging @ 2026-03-22T14:00Z :rocket:
maya: accessibility: reasons need aria-labels and keyboard expand/collapse. katie pls add to checklist.
katie: will do. also add an opt-out for org-level admins via policy if they prefer no simulation for compliance.
leo: need to consider caching invalidation when role bindings change — event-driven flush.
sam: backend will watch role-binding webhook and invalidate sim cache.
maya: ok I'll prototype the UI and open a short RFC + demo. tagging @sam for API and @leo for perf review. Thanks :pray:
leo: ping me when you have perf numbers, happy to test with large shard.
sam: will carve out time to review the API contract tomorrow.
